actual_controller_internal: material-carried per-cue numerator/support/innovation/age plus eligibility/current_cue/cue_paid; host active/pending/due are not passed to prepare

partition_interpretation.instant_resource_empty: only inventory is empty; does not imply full host-public or body state is history-free
partition_interpretation.full_public: original reusable adapter describes host-public interface, not the narrower deployed d3 policy
partition_interpretation.body: active/pending and due must remain in body/pipeline matching even when hidden from actual controller; rho/energy can also reflect history
partition_interpretation.phase: public phase/constant delay give timing, not unknown mapping; all arms share this scaffold

sensory_vs_writer.sensor: paid detect + legal old survivor + mature capacity coverage; local completed_mask/local_label
sensory_vs_writer.writer: sensor valid AND surviving cue eligibility AND cue_paid AND memory_unpaid==0; frozen suppresses update but transport/death/age still evolve
sensory_vs_writer.missing: unobserved label=-1; writer ineligibility is not automatically sensor missingness

record_timing.phase4: prechoice commit then post5; paid success retires old active and schedules pending
record_timing.phase12: mature then shift/keep then detect payment then resource input then label/uptake then birth/export then post13 then writer
record_timing.frames: 832 post-host/post-settle frames from first heldout seed changed condition; prediction post-write, phase4 requested actual, other-phase requested stale last_requested

available: per_step all scalars; sparse array frames; stage-end full environment and controller checkpoints; these do not supply all missing before-choice records
provenance_id: source SHA + stored stage/clock/cell may index a saved record; it is not an emitted opaque event or newly observed event
